_about: Corrections register for the publish finalize program, following Gray Matter's corrective-action protocol. One record per problem in corrections/<id>.md. A correction closes only with changed_files, regression_evidence and a named reviewer_approval. No record in this file is closed. Status vocabulary: open | closed. Owner decisions are marked decision_owner: owner. Merged records group related findings to fit the design map budget (docs/design/README.md, 9000 bytes).

corrections.problem: Life is opt-in behind a preview-named flag that defaults off, although the native board names Life as the single Wallet direction. A second Week surface (WeekFocusSurface) is reachable only through a path that cannot run, and Life and Classic remove a responsibility differently. Decided by OD18 and OD19; not yet in code.
corrections.decision_owner: decided: OD18 (Life is the default root; flag key kept) and OD19 (delete dead Week Focus code in wave 2). Open until the code lands.

corrections.problem: Health had three values (#007AFF default role, #30B0C7 category, #0A84FF landing), and School shared #007AFF. OD21 makes Health teal #30B0C7 everywhere. The landing sample is updated here; the model.ts default and the native hardcoded values are still open. OD23 settles the gradient: it stays on one lit action per surface.
corrections.decision_owner: decided: OD21 (Health teal #30B0C7 everywhere; landing sample updated in this PR; model.ts default in wave 2). OD23 keeps the accent gradient on the one lit action per surface. Native hardcoded values remain for lane A.

corrections.problem: Creating a responsibility has three names on main: the sheet title is 'Add Life', the Classic entry says 'New Spread', and the Classic empty state says 'Create responsibility'. The words are now decided (OD7: Life areas in Life, responsibilities in Classic; 'spread' never names a role). The code has not changed yet. 'To place' also still appears with two capitalizations.
corrections.decision_owner: decided: OD7 and OD22 (Life: Life area and Add Life; Classic: responsibility and Add responsibility; always To place; empty states are heading, one sentence, action). Application open in lanes A, C, D.

corrections.problem: CLAUDE.md and the release plan disagreed about device scope. OD20 makes Spread 1.0 iPhone only. OD25 keeps the TestFlight invitation and adds no App Store link until the listing exists. The superseding note in APP_STORE_RELEASE_PLAN.md is not on this branch yet.
corrections.decision_owner: decided: OD20 (Spread 1.0 is iPhone only; supersedes the October universal line in APP_STORE_RELEASE_PLAN.md) and OD25 (no App Store link until the listing exists). The superseding note is in the owner-docs PR, not on this branch.

corrections.problem: Three decisions from the wave-1 review are not yet in code: the remaining Lucide icon assets (OD11), the disabled-control opacity token Spread.disabledOpacity = 0.4 (OD17), and naming the Week sidebar scrim as a token (OD16). They belong to wave 2.
